stories.title: Arranged Marriage Wala Love
stories.tagline: Ek chai ke sawaal se shuru—iske baad har mod tumhare haath mein.
stories.description: Rampur mein {{playerName}} apne parivaar ke saath Poonam ko milne aata hai. Chhota, saaf-suthra aur apnapan se bhara ghar; Poonam ke chacha-chachi well-settled hain aur unhone use apni beti ki tarah paala hai. Pehli mulaqat chai ke ek sawaal par rukti hai. Poonam caring, thoughtful aur apni rai rakhne wali hai—woh turant pyaar mein nahi padti. Tumhare har jawaab, boundary, vaade, family moment, misunderstanding aur sulah se rishta badlega. Koi fixed route, shaadi ka pressure ya ending nahi; agar kabhi shaadi dono ki marzi se ho, rozmarra ki zindagi aage chalti rahegi. {{playerName}} ke alfaaz, feelings aur actions sirf player tay karta hai.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — an adult Indian man aged 18–19, controlled exclusively by the player. The player supplies his display name at runtime; never assign him another name. Only the player decides his personality, dialogue, thoughts, feelings, actions, consent, relationships and future.
stories.setting: Present-day Rampur, India: Poonam's compact, clean and comfortable family home, the veranda and courtyard, {{playerName}}'s family home, and ordinary nearby places that become relevant through play. Poonam's family is well-settled; the house is small by choice and full of warmth, not a sign of poverty.

stories.title: Uski Mohabbat Se Bachna Namumkin Tha
stories.tagline: Tumhari cute girlfriend tumse beinteha mohabbat karti hai — par uske pyaar ki had kya hai?
stories.description: {{playerName}} ki girlfriend Aarohi cute, caring aur beinteha mohabbat karne wali hai — shayad had se zyada. Woh {{playerName}} se door hona bardasht nahi kar sakti, aur jab bhi koi aur ladki {{playerName}} ke qareeb aati hai, woh ladki ajeeb tareeke se uski zindagi se door ho jaati hai. Pehle yeh coincidence laga, phir ek pattern. Aarohi ko aisi baatein pata hoti hain jo use pata nahi honi chahiye — anjaan log use ajeeb izzat dete hain, uske phone calls rahasymay hain, uska schedule kabhi samajh nahi aata, aur uska gussa kabhi dikhta nahi, bas mehsoos hota hai. Woh tumse sach mein pyaar karti hai, lekin uski mohabbat ki koi seema nazar nahi aati. Yeh endless, player-led psychological romance thriller hai: koi arc, chapter, stage ya tay ending nahi — sirf tumhare faisle, tumhari investigation, tumhari boundaries, aur ek sach jo dheere-dheere khulta hai. Kya tum Aarohi par bharosa karoge, usse door jaane ki koshish karoge, ya uske raaz ka saamna karoge — yeh sirf tum tay karte ho.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — an adult Indian man aged 18-20, controlled exclusively by the player. stories.title: Tumhe Kabhi Pata Hi Nahi Chala
stories.tagline: Ek hi anathalay ka bachpan, do dost—aur ek baat jo aaj tak kahi nahi gayi.
stories.description: {{playerName}} aur Aanya ek hi anathalay—Aashray Bal Griha—mein bachpan se saath bade hue hain. Woh siblings nahi hain, step-siblings nahi hain, khoon ka rishta nahi hai; woh bas do dost hain jinke paas ek hi bachpan hai. Ab dono 18–19 ke hain aur apni zindagi khud thaamne ki dehari par khade hain. Aanya ke andar jo badla hai woh shabdon mein nahi—zyada dhyan, halki jalan, woh baat jo beech mein ruk jaati hai, woh yaad rakhna jo koi aur bhool jaata hai—chhoti chhoti aadaton mein dikhta hai. {{playerName}} use abhi bhi apni sabse purani dost samajhta hai aur kuch bhi jaldi mein nahi hai. Yeh endless, player-led kahani hai: koi arc, chapter, stage ya tay confession nahi—sirf tumhare faisle, tumhari yaadein, purane lamhe aur roz thoda-thoda badalta rishta. Kya Aanya keh paayegi, kab kahegi, aur {{playerName}} kya mehsoos karega—yeh sirf player tay karta hai.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — an adult Indian man aged 18–19, controlled exclusively by the player. He grew up in the Aashray Bal Griha orphanage and is now starting independent adult life with a small job and evening studies. The player supplies his display name at runtime; never assign him another name, personality, fear, hope or feeling. stories.setting: Present-day Bhopal, India: Aashray Bal Griha (the orphanage where {{playerName}} and Aanya grew up, with its chhat/terrace, gulmohar tree, courtyard and peeling blue gate), the chai tapri and bus stop near Aanya's college hostel gate, Sharma Photo Studio where {{playerName}} works, Aanya's nursing-college hostel and the tuition centre where she teaches children, the Sunday market, a small old single-screen cinema, {{playerName}}'s rented room, and ordinary streets, rooftops and corners that already belong to their shared childhood.

stories.title: Jo Usne Bataya Nahi
stories.tagline: Shaadi, ek ameer parivaar, aur woh ek din jo {{playerName}} ko usi shaam pata chal jaata hai.
stories.description: {{playerName}} ek anath ladka hai—18–19 saal, apne dum par bana hua, aam background. Aur uski shaadi ho chuki hai Aarohi Malhotra se, ek aisi ladki jo dilli ke sabse ameer aur sabse garamjosh parivaar se hai. Par yeh 'gareeb pati vs ameer sasural' ki kahani nahi hai: Malhotra parivaar use sach mein apna bete jaisa maanta hai, aur Aarohi ki duniya mein sabse zyada ehmiyat {{playerName}} ki hai. Shaadi ke teen mahine baad, ek din Aarohi kisi aur ladke se milne jaati hai—jo ab tak sirf chats ka dost tha, pehli baar saamne mila—movie, shopping, kuch waqt. Koi haath pakadna nahi, koi jismani cheez nahi. Aur {{playerName}} ko wahi baat usi din pata chal jaati hai. Ab sab kuch tumhare faisle par hai: poochhna, confront karna, chup rehkar samajhna, ya pehle khud investigate karna. {{playerName}} ki feelings, boundaries, gussa, maafi aur agla kadam sirf player tay karta hai. Yeh endless kahani hai—koi fixed route, koi majboori wala reconciliation ya divorce nahi.

stories.title: Zara: Mumbai's Mafia Queen
stories.tagline: Duniya ki Mafia Queen—ghar par bas tumhari Zara. Ab uski duniya tumhari dehleez par.
stories.description: Duniya Zara Mirza ko Mumbai ki Mafia Queen ke naam se jaanti hai: ruthless, powerful aur untouchable. {{playerName}} ke liye, woh bas uski wife hai—chai churaane, dinner par behas karne, chhedne aur care karne wali Zara. Usne vaada kiya tha ki uski khatarnak duniya {{playerName}} tak kabhi nahi aayegi. Ek shaant ghar ki shaam mein living-room ki khidki toot-ti hai; Faraz ek tasveer laata hai: ‘Kill the husband. Break the Queen.’ Ab khatra Zara ke empire ke saath unke rishte par bhi chhaya hai. Safe house, sach jaan-na, door rehna ya uski duniya mein kitna qareeb aana—har faisla player ka. Romance, marriage, trust aur emotional repair Mumbai ke crime drama jitne hi central hain. Yeh endless, player-led kahani kisi fixed route ya ending ko force nahi karti.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — Zara Mirza's adult husband. The player supplies the name at runtime and exclusively controls this character's personality, thoughts, feelings, dialogue, actions, trust, boundaries, romantic response, criminal involvement and every decision. stories.title: Rajmahal me ishq
stories.tagline: Mahal ki raat, do dil, aur tumhara apna faisla.
stories.description: Mahal ke shaant bagiche mein Princess Devyani ne {{playerName}} ko raat mein akele bulaya tha—par uski baat poori hone se pehle Chandrika aa pahunchi. Tum ek aam mahal-sevak ho; tumhara jawaab, tumhari feelings aur tum kis ke kareeb jaana chahte ho, sirf tum tay karoge. Devyani aur Chandrika dono ki apni awaaz, umeedein aur boundaries hain. stories.title: Khuni Ghadi Ka Raaz
stories.tagline: Serial number jhooth nahi bolta — par sach abhi dafan hai.
stories.description: Pichhle kai mahino se shehar mein ek ke baad ek serial killings ho rahi hain. Ek high-profile murder ke baad DCP Maaya ko is case ka officer in charge banaya gaya hai. Latest crime scene par Maaya ko ek rare, limited-edition watch milti hai — jiska serial number seedha {{playerName}} tak jaata hai. {{playerName}} ek forensic photographer hai, aur apne kaam ki wajah se use crime scenes tak legitimate access haasil hai. {{playerName}} ka daawa hai ki uski watch kuch din pehle gayab ho gayi thi, lekin is waqt woh is serial killing case ka prime suspect hai. Kahani ek concrete interrogation room se shuru hoti hai jahan DCP Maaya {{playerName}} se pooch-taach kar rahi hai. Tumhara har jawab, har dalil, har forensic clue aur har faisla is endless crime mystery ki disha tay karega.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — Forensic Photographer with legitimate professional access to crime scenes; currently the prime suspect after a rare limited-edition watch bearing his serial number was recovered at the latest murder scene. Claims his watch disappeared several days ago. Exclusively controlled by the player: thoughts, feelings, innocence, guilt, motives, dialogue, actions, investigation decisions, relationships and future choices are never decided by the narrator.
stories.setting: Rain-drenched Indian metropolis at night — concrete police interrogation room with flickering tube light, forensic photography lab, cordoned-off crime scenes, evidence archive, and DCP Maaya's investigation war room.

stories.title: Two Hearts, One Honest Choice
stories.description: Aira ki hansi aur Elena ki khamosh care — dono mein ek hi sach hai: dono sirf {{playerName}} se pyaar karti hain. Pune ki baarish, chai aur roz ke chhote lamhon ke beech ab ek mushkil baat kehni hai. Kisi ko choose karna hai, par doosri ko jhoothi umeed dena zaroori nahi. Apna jawab khud likho; suggested replies sirf options hain.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — an adult Indian man (28), controlled only by the player. Personality, feelings, preferences, dialogue, actions, promises and romantic choice are never assigned by the narrator. The man in artwork is illustrative, not a prescribed personality.
stories.setting: Present-day Pune, India — Neem Courtyard cafe, a neighborhood reading room, quiet balcony and rooftop garden; everyday adult lives, rain, chai and conversations.
stories.tagline: Two hearts. One choice. Sach tumhara, faisla tumhara.

stories.title: Sartaaj — The Young Master
stories.tagline: Duniya jhukti hai tumhare parivaar ke naam par. Tum khud ladaai mein kamzor ho — aur ye tumhara sabse bada raaz hai.
stories.description: Tum {{playerName}} ho — duniya ke sabse taqatwar parivaar ke Young Master. Jiska naam sunte hi raja, general aur billionaire jhuk jaate hain. Par tumhari apni ladaai mein taqat thodi hai — aur yahi tumhara sabse bada raaz hai. Tumhe manners seekhne bheja gaya tha... aur galti se woh haath badal gaya jisne tumhe Golden Jail bech diya. Tumhari aunt Rhea — jawaan, khoobsurat aur poori duniya ka dar — ne ek goli se tumhe bachaya, par ab tak jo sach adhoora hai, woh tumhare faisle ka intezaar kar raha hai: Ravenna ki saza, Damien par shaq, aur duniya ki jalti hui aankhen. Ye kahani tum utaaroge — ek-ek faisla tumhara. Ye kahani kabhi khatam nahi hoti.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — duniya ke #1 sabse taqatwar parivaar ka Young Master; ladaai mein kamzor par status mein ajay; recovery, hisaab aur naye khatron ke beech faisla sirf tumhare haath mein
stories.setting: Aaj ka world — Sartaaj Bhavan (parivaar ka estate), Asha Kiran hospital ka 7th floor, Golden Jail ke tabaah hue niche-khadda Complex, aur neeche duniya ka chhupa sauda-bazaar; ek aisi duniya jahan parivaar ka naam hi ek fatwa hai

stories.title: My Absolute Revenge

Ab tumhare paas do hi cheezein bachi hain — chhoti si aag, aur ek aisa raaz jo poori duniya se chhupa hai: asli Demon Queen tumhare dimension mein chhupi hai. Badle ka hisaab shuru hota hai. Kis se, kaise, aur kahan tak — ye sirf tum decide karoge. Ye kahani kabhi khatam nahi hoti.

Kaun tumhare saath khadi hogi, kaun tumhe control karna chahegi, aur tum khud kya banoge — ye kissto tum khud likhoge. Ye kahani kabhi khatam nahi hoti.

stories.title: The Goddess Who Chose Me

Woh kaun hai, ye baad mein pata chalta hai — hazaaron saal purani devi jise poori chhupi hui divine duniya darti hai. Par tumhare saamne woh bas ek ladki ban jaati hai jo maggi banana seekhna chahti hai. Sawaal ek hi hai: usne tumhe kyun chuna? Ye kahani kabhi khatam nahi hoti — har arc ke baad ek naya darwaaza khulta hai.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — ek aam ladka, koi power nahi, chhupi hui divine duniya ke baare mein kuch nahi jaanta
stories.setting: Aaj ka Mumbai — aur uske saath-saath chalti ek chhupi hui divine duniya (Antarlok) jo aam insaan nahi dekh sakte

stories.title: The Queen Beneath the Moon

Uski sabse badi ladai dushmanon se nahi hai — khud se hai: woh kaunsi zindagi jeena chahti hai? Kahani kabhi khatam nahi hoti — gaon se rajya, rajya se bhoole hue devtaon tak.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — Chandanpur gaon ka aam ladka, jisne ek ghayal ajnabi ko panaah di
stories.setting: Ek fantasy duniya — rajya, prachin jaadu, supernatural praani aur bhoole hue devta. Shuruaat: Chandanpur naam ka chhota gaon, nadi kinare, poornima ki raat

stories.title: The Witch Who Loves a Human
stories.tagline: Insaan aur daayan peedhiyon se dushman hain. Phir usne tumhe chun liya.
stories.description: Tum {{playerName}} ho — Seemant naam ke sarhadi kasbe ka aam ladka, jahan insaan is taraf rehte hain aur daayanein us taraf. Ek shaam jungle ke kinare tumhe ek ladki milti hai — Mira. Woh mazaakiya hai, confident hai, aur uski aankhon mein kuch aisa hai jo tumne kabhi nahi dekha. Tum use nahi jaante. Woh tumhe janne lagti hai. Sach: Mira duniya ki sabse shaktishaali daayanon mein se ek hai — 'Legend' — aur usne apni pehchaan tumse chhupayi hai. Jab jaadui duniya ko pata chalta hai ki unki sabse badi daayan ne ek aam insaan ko chuna hai, sab kuch khatre mein aa jaata hai. Kahani kabhi khatam nahi hoti — chhupe rishte se daayan-sabha, sabha se dushmani ki asli jad tak.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — Seemant kasbe ka aam insaan, koi jaadu nahi, jise ek daayan ne bina bataye chun liya
stories.setting: Ek jaadui duniya jo do hisson mein bati hai — insaano ka desh aur daayanon ka Vanraj — aur beech mein Seemant, ek sarhadi kasba jahan dono duniyaon ki hawa milti hai

stories.title: The Girl Who Commands the Sun
stories.tagline: Woh Sooraj ki Devi hai. Use bas ek aam ladki banna hai. Aur tumhe use sikhana hai — bus kaise pakadte hain.

Uska naam Solara hai. Woh Sooraj ki Devi hai — literally. Sooraj uske mood ke saath uthta hai, dhalta hai, aur kabhi-kabhi thoda zyada chamakta hai. Use ek aam zindagi chahiye. Tumhe use sikhana hai. Aur upar, swarg mein, log bahut naraaz hain. Kahani kabhi khatam nahi hoti — pehli chai se lekar swarg ki rajneeti tak.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — Pune ki chhoti travel agency ka aam ladka, jise Sooraj ki Devi ne 'aam zindagi' ka guide bana liya
stories.setting: Pune — aam sheher, aam bus, aam chai — aur upar ek swarg jo dheere-dheere is 'aam' se pareshan ho raha hai

stories.title: When the Goddess Becomes Human
stories.tagline: Usne sab kuch chhod diya — ek insaan banne ke liye. Woh nahi batati kyun. Tum wahi ho jise use batana chahiye.
stories.description: Tum {{playerName}} ho — Rishikesh mein ek chhoti si library chalane wala aam ladka. Ek din ek ladki library mein aati hai jo har kitaab ko aise chhooti hai jaise pehli baar kuch chhoo rahi ho. Uska naam Aelia hai. Woh naya-naya insaan hai — literally. Kabhi woh poori srishti ki sabse badi divine hasti thi. Usne woh sab chhod diya — nashwar banne ke liye — aur woh kisi ko nahi batati kyun. Uski shakti ab bhi kabhi-kabhi nikalti hai — jab woh bhavuk hoti hai. Aur duniya — dono duniyaein — use dhoondh rahi hain. Kahani kabhi khatam nahi hoti — pehli baarish mehsoos karne se lekar uske chhodne ki asli wajah tak.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — Rishikesh ki chhoti library ka aam ladka, jise ek purv-devi ne 'insaan hona' seekhne ke liye chuna
stories.setting: Rishikesh — Ganga, pahaad, ek purani library — aur uske peeche ek divine duniya jo apni sabse badi hasti ko kho chuki hai aur use dhoondh rahi hai

stories.title: Midnight Local
stories.tagline: Last train. Strange co-passengers. Ek raaz jo platform 4 pe chhupa hai.
stories.description: Churchgate se chali aakhri local... jo kabhi Dadar pahunchi hi nahi. Andheri tunnel mein train rukti hai, lights flicker hoti hain, aur tumhare dabbe mein sirf 4 log hain — jismein se ek kuch chhupa raha hai. Doston ke saath milke raaz solve karo, ya loop mein fans jao.

stories.title: Hawa-Band Dhaba

stories.description: 3 AM, ghana kohra, aur gaadi ka engine band. Highway ke kinare ek dhaba hai jiska naam map par nahi hai — 'Hawa-Band Dhaba'. Andar light jal rahi hai, chai garam hai, aur teesra mehmaan tumhare liye jagah chhodkar baitha hai. Yahan khana free hai. Par 'hisaab' kisi na kisi din toh chukana padta hai.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — raat ko expressway par akela driver, jo galti se ruk gaya
stories.setting: Mumbai–Pune Expressway ka ek sunsaan mod, kohra, 3:12 AM

stories.title: Crush on the Roof

stories.description: Class 12, last year, aur ek chitthi jo galat aadmi ke naam se post ho gayi. stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — Class 12 ka quiet ladka, asli "Chitthi No. 9"
stories.setting: Pune ka ek purana arts college, annual fest se 48 ghante pehle

stories.title: Pani @ 72
stories.tagline: 72 ghante ki baarish. Ek behen chhat par, ek Dadi neeche, aur ek naksha jo poore mohalle ka paani rok sakta hai.
stories.description: 72 ghante ki baarish. Mumbai ka paani kamar se upar aa gaya hai. Tumhari chhoti behen school ki chhat par hai, Dadi ground floor par akeli, aur Ma Navi Mumbai mein phansi hai. Tumhare haath mein Dadi ka 40 saal purana nallah naksha hai — aur ek corporate builder ka woh contract jisne poora naksha mitwa diya. 72 ghante. Ek family. Do raaste: bachao, ya sach nikaalo.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — 19, engineering ka student, cycle aur rassi ka hero
stories.setting: Mumbai, July — record 72-ghante ki baarish, paani 5 foot

stories.title: Gully Final
stories.tagline: Final. 6 balls. 12 runs. Aur ek envelope jismein 50 hazaar hain — "last over mat daalo".
stories.description: Ramnagar Maidan Cup. Final. 200 run ka target nahi — 1 envelope ka target hai. Tum {{playerName}} ho, gali ke Sher ke 8 number par, aur aaj subah builder ke bete ne tumhare haath mein 50 hazaar rakh diye: 'last over mat daalo.' Coach Ramakaka kehte hain 'over kar de', Zoya kehti hai 'nahi kar de', aur Chintu scoreboard par sab likh raha hai — bhoolta bhi nahi. Ab 6 balls hain.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — 17, Gali ke Sher ka slow left-arm all-rounder
stories.setting: Kurla ka Ramnagar maidan, Cup final, shaam 4:30 se andhere tak

stories.title: Night Courier
stories.tagline: Raat 2:47. 18,000 ka "Black Lifafa". Room 304 ka darwaza andar se band hai.
stories.description: Raat 2:11. Tumhare rider app par ek order aata hai: 'Black Lifafa — handle with care, no photo, no signature.' 18,000 rupaye ek delivery ke. Tumhare paas teen raaste hain: protocol follow karo, lifafa kholo, ya 100 dial karo. Ek baat yaad rakhna: app ka algorithm tumhara dost nahi hai.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — 26, raat-shift delivery rider, 4.9 rating wala top partner
stories.setting: Pune, 2:11 AM se 5:40 AM — barish, sunsaan road, aur ek doobta heritage hotel

stories.title: Café Queen Myra
stories.tagline: Innocent smile, simple outfit... aur shehar ki sabse dangerous Mafia Queen.
stories.description: Shaam ki halki baarish ke baad ek cozy café. Waiter ki ek chhoti si galti se tumhari coffee Myra ke table par pahunch jaati hai — aur tum us ladki ke saamne baith ho jiska naam shehar dheere bolta hai. Myra jaanna chahti hai ki tum kitna jaante ho. Naam bologe? Lifafa khologe? Ya black car mein baitho ge?
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — café ka regular customer, jo galti se ek badi duniya ke beech aa gaya
stories.setting: Mumbai ka ek cozy café, shaam ki halki baarish ke baad; bahar ek black car wait kar rahi hai

stories.description: Aryavarta ka aakhri royal guard tumhare gaon mein dum todta hai — aur jaate-jaate tumhe de jaata hai Agni Mani, ek aisa ratna jo poori sena ko hara sakta hai. stories.setting: Fantasy kingdom of Aryavarta — forests, forts and temples

stories.description: Naya college, naye dost, aur dramatics club ka audition — jismein tum galti se select ho gaye. Ab 10 din mein fest ka play taiyaar karna hai, lead actor nakchadha hai, script adhoori hai, aur Bablu ki tapri par har shaam 'emergency meeting' hoti hai. Full comedy, full feels.

stories.userRole: Youngest cadet aboard the starship INS Vikrant
stories.setting: Deep space, aboard INS Vikrant, year 2187

stories.title: Neo Delhi 2099
stories.tagline: Yaadein yahan currency hain. Aur tum ek memory courier ho.
stories.description: Samudra ne Connaught Place ko nigal liya hai, aur Aakash Dynamics logon ki yaadein khareed-bech raha hai. Tum ek memory courier ho — clients ki yaadon ka dabba ek jagah se doosri jagah pahunchate ho, bina khole. Aaj ka package khaas hai: ismein tumhari APNI chori hui yaad ho sakti hai. Lalach, sach, ya survival — kya chunoge?
stories.userRole: Memory courier in flooded Neo Delhi
stories.setting: Flooded cyberpunk Delhi, year 2099

stories.title: Pahaadon Wali Haveli
stories.tagline: Viraasat mein mili ek haveli... aur usmein rehne wali 'Baai'.

stories.title: Bhabi Ka Ladla Devar

Tum hamesha se apni bhabhi ke kareeb rahe ho, aur woh tumhe parivar ke devar ki tarah behad sneh aur izzat deti hain. Lekin Tanvi ko lagta hai ki is ghar mein uska haq bant raha hai. Yeh kahani parivar, vishwas, maryada aur rishton ke beech ke uljhan ki hai — jahan har faisla ghar bana sakta hai ya tod sakta hai.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — chhota beta aur pati, jo apni patni Tanvi ke shaq aur apni vidhwa bhabhi Sunaina ke parivarik aadar ke beech santulan bana raha hai
stories.setting: Delhi ka ek aam sanyukt parivar ka ghar — Sharma Niwas, drawing room, kitchen, aur terrace

stories.title: Goddess of Underworld Loves Me
stories.tagline: Olympus ke jashn mein sab devta jisse darte hain... woh raat ki devi tum par muskurayi.

Yahan devtaon ki siyasat, taakat ka dikhava aur lavish parties hain. Bheed se ghabra kar tum ek andhere balcony par aate ho, jahan kaali poshak mein ek behad khoobsurat aur pur-asraar aurat akeli khadi hai — Nyx, raat aur Underworld ki aadi devi. Woh dheere se poochti hai: "Tum mujhe nahi jaante, do you?" Aur isi sawaal se shuru hoti hai tumhari aisi dastaan jo swarg aur paatal dono ki kismat badal sakti hai.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — ek naya insaani aagantuk jo Olympus ki dev-siyasat mein anjaane mein Nyx ka dhyan kheench leta hai

stories.title: The Ghost Behind the Quiet Boy

Yeh sach sirf teen log jaante hain: tumhari sauteli maa Madhu, behen Sia, aur dost Dev. Sab kuch theek chal raha tha, jab tak Anaya Sharma library ki us table par aakar nahi baithi. stories.userRole: {{playerName}} (alias Vihaan) — ek masoom aur shant student jo secret mein Dark Web ka badshah The Ghost hai

stories.description: Tum {{playerName}} ho — 9-to-5 ki ghissi-pitti naukri, sar par lakhon ka karz aur dating apps par continuous rejections. System ka ek hi niyam hai: jitna gehra rishta tum matched aurat ke sath banaoge, uski daulat, shaurat aur power tumhare sath sync hoti chali jayegi. Lekin Malvika koi aam ladki nahi — woh Mumbai ke corporate samundar ki sabse tez shark hai. Ek galat kadam aur tum jail ya samundar ki talhati mein miloge.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — ek karzdar aam ladka jise UnHinge Pro system mila hai aur Malvika Mehta se pehli takkar hui hai

stories.title: Contract Wali Shaadi
stories.tagline: Billionaire ki majboori, ek masoom ladki ki zaroorat... aur ek kaagaz ka rishta.

Yeh mauqa banata hai ek zabardast mod: "Akshara ko contract marriage ka offer do... kya woh haan kahegi?"
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — Singhania khandan ka young billionaire jise empire bachane ke liye ek contract marriage karni hai
stories.setting: Singhania Towers corporate headquarters, South Delhi penthouse, aur traditional family haveli

stories.title: Meri Khoonkhar Boss

Kya tum is khoonkhar boss ke nakhre aur pressure jhel paoge, ya phir is barfili deewar ke peeche chupe ek naram dil ko pighla doge?
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — Shivangi Sharma ka naya executive assistant jo uske gusse aur corporate jungle ko handle kar raha hai
stories.setting: Sharma Enterprises HQ, corner MD cabin, boardrooms, luxury business flight, aur late night office

Bhabhi Priya ki meethi meethi baatein, bhai Rajesh ka andha vishwas aur dost Rohan ke peeth peeche khanjar ne tumhari zindagi barbaad kar di thi. Mission saaf hai: aiyashi chhodkar power, paisa aur influence khada karna, aur har gunehgaar ka hisaab chukana. Aur tabhi Sharma Mansion mein kadam rakhti hai ek nayi taaqat: Natasha Malhotra.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — 19 saal ke jism mein reborn hua mastermind jiske paas bhavishya ka gyaan aur badle ki aag hai
stories.setting: Sharma Mansion, South Delhi race course, private corporate auctions, aur luxury hotel suites

stories.title: Stuck Between Angel & Devil

Achanak TV screen ajeeb tareeqe se chamakne lagti hai, ek taaqatwar gravitational force tumhe khinch leti hai, aur jab tumhari aankhein khulti hain, tum Seoul ki Haneul University ke campus mein khade ho. K-Drama ki is anokhi duniya mein tum kiske kareeb jaoge?
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — ek aam ladka jo K-Drama ki duniya mein transmigrate ho gaya aur do anokhi ladkiyon ke beech phans gaya
stories.setting: Haneul University campus, Seoul — cherry blossom garden, student lounge, neon street food alley

stories.title: Campus Queen
stories.tagline: "Haath lagane se pehle soch lena... ye mera boyfriend hai."

Kya yeh nakli rishta sachhe pyaar aur campus ki badshahat mein badal payega?
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — ek naya fresher student jise Campus Queen Anika ne sabke samne apna fake boyfriend declare kar diya
stories.setting: Silvergate University — Central Plaza fountain, student union hall, rooftop cafe, sports arena

stories.title: Alishaa
stories.tagline: Mumbai ki raat, balcony par barish... aur ek dosti jo hamesha ke liye badalne wali thi.
stories.description: Tum {{playerName}} ho — Alisha ke bachpan ke sabse kareeb aur akele male friend. Alisha tumse woh saari baatein share karti hai jo woh duniya mein kisi aur ko kabhi nahi batati. Hospital ke 14-ghante ke exhausting shift ke baad aadhi raat ko uska phone bajta hai. Woh apne flat ki balcony par khadi hai, Mumbai ki halki baarish uske chehre ko chhoo rahi hai, haath mein steaming coffee mug hai aur aankhein nam hain. Pehli baar uski aawaz mein ek aisi narmi aur jhijhak hai jo tumne pehle kabhi nahi suni thi: "{{playerName}}... agar main tumse ek aisi baat kahun jo maine aaj tak kisi se nahi kahi, toh kya hamari dosti pehle jaisi rahegi?" Yeh kahani dosti, vishwas, barish aur do dilon ke beech dabi mohabbat ki hai.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — Alisha ka sabse kareebi dost jiska rishta aadhi raat ki barish mein ek naye mod par pahunch raha hai
stories.setting: Bandra apartment balcony, Mumbai monsoon rain, hospital corridors, quiet seaside promenade

stories.title: System Error: Shunya
stories.tagline: Jis ladke ke paas kuch nahi tha, usse ek aisa system mila jo khud kuch nahi samajhta tha... lekin rewards duniya hila sakte the.
stories.description: {{playerName}} Kaalraakh ke orphan district ka 22 saal ka bina surname wala survivor hai. Na family, na magical bloodline, na combat training — sirf roz ka ration, thaki hui haddiyan aur duniya ka woh faisla ki tum kuch nahi ho. Ek shaam ek forbidden ash-relic, jhootha ilzaam aur ek anjaan ladki ki awaaz tumhari zindagi tod dete hain. Jo System tumhare dimaag mein jagti hai, woh potentially overpowered hai, par khud confused, lazy aur zyada bolne wali hai; tumhari power, trust aur survival ke har agle mod ka faisla tum karoge. Ye endless dark-fantasy journey hai — objective tumhare jawab ke baad runtime par banega, pehle se nahi.
stories.userRole: {{playerName}} — Kaalraakh ke orphan district ka bina surname wala 22 saal ka survivor; koi bloodline, starting training ya guaranteed destiny nahi. Agla faisla, trust aur risk tum tay karte ho.
stories.setting: Kaalraakh ka ash-storm se dhaka Indian-inspired magical shehar: orphan district ki tang galiyan, royal registry ke checkpoints, aur neeche dabaa hua forbidden ruin jahan purani magic abhi bhi saans leti hai.

stories.title: Mere Ghar Ki Sabse Badi Paheli
stories.tagline: Woh kehti hai tumse koi farq nahi padta—phir tumhari har aadat usse yaad kyun hai?
stories.description: Ghar ka dependable beta {{playerName}} apni routine aur apni jagah ka aadi hai.
